-- ============================================================================
-- 1. PHYSICAL RELATIONAL SCHEMA (Table-Per-Class Pattern)
-- ============================================================================

-- Leaf Class: Person (Subclass of Party)
CREATE TABLE People (
    PersonId INT64 NOT NULL,
    Name STRING(MAX) NOT NULL,
) PRIMARY KEY (PersonId);

-- Leaf Class: Organization (Subclass of Party)
CREATE TABLE Organizations (
    OrganizationId INT64 NOT NULL,
    Name STRING(MAX) NOT NULL,
) PRIMARY KEY (OrganizationId);

-- Leaf Class: PersonalAccount (Subclass of Account)
-- Equivalent Class 'HighRiskAccount' is implemented via a STORED Generated Column.
CREATE TABLE PersonalAccounts (
    AccountId INT64 NOT NULL,
    AccountBalance NUMERIC NOT NULL,
    IsHighRisk BOOL AS (AccountBalance > 100000.00) STORED,
) PRIMARY KEY (AccountId);

-- Leaf Class: CorporateAccount (Subclass of Account)
-- Equivalent Class 'HighRiskAccount' is implemented via a STORED Generated Column.
CREATE TABLE CorporateAccounts (
    AccountId INT64 NOT NULL,
    AccountBalance NUMERIC NOT NULL,
    IsHighRisk BOOL AS (AccountBalance > 100000.00) STORED,
) PRIMARY KEY (AccountId);

-- Object Property: hasOwner (PersonalAccount -> Person)
CREATE TABLE PersonalAccountOwners (
    AccountId INT64 NOT NULL,
    PersonId INT64 NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT FK_PersAccOwn_Acc FOREIGN KEY (AccountId) REFERENCES PersonalAccounts (AccountId),
    CONSTRAINT FK_PersAccOwn_Pers FOREIGN KEY (PersonId) REFERENCES People (PersonId),
) PRIMARY KEY (AccountId, PersonId);

-- Object Property: hasOwner (CorporateAccount -> Organization)
CREATE TABLE CorporateAccountOwners (
    AccountId INT64 NOT NULL,
    OrganizationId INT64 NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT FK_CorpAccOwn_Acc FOREIGN KEY (AccountId) REFERENCES CorporateAccounts (AccountId),
    CONSTRAINT FK_CorpAccOwn_Org FOREIGN KEY (OrganizationId) REFERENCES Organizations (OrganizationId),
) PRIMARY KEY (AccountId, OrganizationId);

-- Object Property: hasSignatory (PersonalAccount -> Person)
CREATE TABLE PersonalAccountSignatories (
    AccountId INT64 NOT NULL,
    PersonId INT64 NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT FK_Sign_Acc FOREIGN KEY (AccountId) REFERENCES PersonalAccounts (AccountId),
    CONSTRAINT FK_Sign_Pers FOREIGN KEY (PersonId) REFERENCES People (PersonId),
) PRIMARY KEY (AccountId, PersonId);

-- Object Property: isPartnerOf (Symmetric: Organization -> Organization)
CREATE TABLE OrganizationPartners (
    OrganizationId INT64 NOT NULL,
    PartnerOrganizationId INT64 NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT FK_Part_Org FOREIGN KEY (OrganizationId) REFERENCES Organizations (OrganizationId),
    CONSTRAINT FK_Part_Partner FOREIGN KEY (PartnerOrganizationId) REFERENCES Organizations (OrganizationId),
) PRIMARY KEY (OrganizationId, PartnerOrganizationId);

-- Object Property: subAccountOf (Transitive: PersonalAccount -> PersonalAccount)
-- Implemented as an Interleaved Table to optimize hierarchical parent-child lookups.
CREATE TABLE PersonalSubAccounts (

    CONSTRAINT FK_CorpSub_Child FOREIGN KEY (SubAccountId) REFERENCES CorporateAccounts (AccountId),

  INTERLEAVE IN PARENT CorporateAccounts ON DELETE CASCADE;
